description: This file implements the TransportSecurityState class and related functions for managing HTTP security policies such as HSTS and HPKP, including handling preload lists, reporting, and certificate policies within the Chromium project.

classes.name: TransportSecurityState
classes.description: Manages HTTP security policies such as HSTS and HPKP, including preload list handling, reporting, and certificate policies.

classes.name: TransportSecurityState::STSState
classes.description: Represents the state of an HSTS policy for a host.

classes.name: TransportSecurityState::PKPState
classes.description: Represents the state of a Public Key Pinning policy for a host.

classes.name: TransportSecurityState::PinSet
classes.description: Defines a set of static pins for HPKP.

classes.name: TransportSecurityState::PinSetInfo
classes.description: Contains information about a host's pinset configuration.

classes.name: HSTSPreloadDecoder
classes.description: Decodes Huffman-encoded preload data for HSTS.

methods.name: GetPEMEncodedChainAsList
methods.description: Returns the PEM-encoded certificate chain as a list of strings.

methods.name: HashReportForCache
methods.description: Computes a hash-based cache key for an HPKP report.

methods.name: GetHPKPReport
methods.description: Generates an HPKP violation report in JSON format.

methods.name: IsReportUriValidForHost
methods.description: Checks if a report URI is valid for a given host to prevent loops.

methods.name: HashesToBase64String
methods.description: Converts a list of hash values to a comma-separated base64 string.

methods.name: HashHost
methods.description: Hashes a canonicalized host using SHA256.

methods.name: HashesIntersect
methods.description: Checks if two hash vectors intersect.

methods.name: AddHash
methods.description: Adds a SHA256 hash to a vector of hashes.

methods.name: CanonicalizeHost
methods.description: Converts a hostname to its canonical DNS form.

methods.name: DecodeHSTSPreload
methods.description: Decodes preload data for a hostname to determine HSTS policies.
